mentions.name: Podcast Summarization Tool
mentions.description: A web app that transcribes and summarizes podcasts and emails the user a summary every morning, helping them keep up with more shows than they have time to listen to.
mentions.problem: Too many podcasts to listen to and not enough time to get through all of them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A podcast summarization tool:

https://podcasts.yayaapps.com/

I have too many podcasts to listen to and realistically not enough time to get through all of them, so I created a web app that transcribes and summarizes your podcasts and emails you a summary every morning.
